en: The image is an illustrated postcard depicting an ornate historic building with detailed architectural features such as decorative window frames, a turret with a pointed roof, and a red-tiled roof. The building is surrounded by a fence and trees, and there are several people walking or standing in front. The card has German text at the top and a small handwritten note. The style of the illustration and the attire of the people suggest an early 20th-century European setting.
